references.text: The same command to tear down altars and smash sacred pillars is given in connection with the conquest of Canaan
Parallel command to tear down altars, smash sacred pillars, and cut down Asherah poles
Moses instructs the Israelites to destroy all idols and shrines when they enter Canaan
Repeats the command to tear down pagan altars, smash sacred pillars, and burn Asherah poles
Gideon carries out this command by tearing down Baal's altar and cutting down the Asherah pole
King Hezekiah fulfills this command by removing the high places, smashing the sacred pillars, and cutting down the Asherah pole
King Asa removes foreign altars and high places, smashes the sacred pillars, and cuts down the Asherah poles
Under Hezekiah, the people tear down the high places, smash the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles
King Josiah purifies Judah by tearing down altars, smashing sacred pillars, and destroying carved images
